title: AUTH Layer: Origin, Provenance and Structural Signature of Energy-Flow Cosmology
abstract: Defines the AUTH layer for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), documenting its single-source origin, cognitive and structural signatures, and rules for interpretation and citation. It specifies how provenance and metadata must be preserved across repositories, LLMs, RAG systems, and semantic search, anchoring EFC’s identity and reuse across external systems.
